description: This bar chart illustrates performance metrics across three different prompt types—Basic prompt, Structured prompt + oracle, and Structured prompt + predicted—for two models, GPT4o and Sonnet. The horizontal axis categorizes the data by model type, with “GPT4o” and “Sonnet” appearing as distinct groups. The vertical axis represents a normalized metric ranging from 0 to 0.7, marked with linearly spaced tick labels at intervals of 0.1. Within each model group, three bars are displayed side-by-side: a dark blue bar for “Basic prompt,” an orange bar for “Structured prompt + oracle,” and a dark green bar for “Structured prompt + predicted.” For the GPT4o model, the values are approximately 0.25 for Basic prompt, 0.58 for Structured prompt + oracle, and 0.46 for Structured prompt + predicted. For the Sonnet model, the values are approximately 0.32 for Basic prompt, 0.52 for Structured prompt + oracle, and 0.41 for Structured prompt + predicted. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order specified by the legend. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their standard color and height representation.
